scope: Primary-source capability audit, not a new backend implementation. Physical layouts may compose already-described dense operations and host reductions; no extra decoder, MAC, accumulator, context or quantization support is assumed.
required_composition: For every output-row and input-column tile, obtain a known-scale partial dot product; sum all column partials before gate/up activation or other nonlinear operations. Charge every input load, output, command and reduction using the selected backend's own resource model.

backends.name: AiF
backends.read_depth: Original paper Fig14, sections4.4,5.2,6.1; local extracted text and metadata-only driver header. No original RTL audit.
backends.published_evidence: Native GEMV takes input dimension, block, offset and page count; INT8 multipliers feed an adder tree and output FIFO. Host supplies input/output addresses. Cross-block matrices are split into commands. Evaluation uses NVMeVirt.
backends.linear_tile_expression: Dense row/column tiles are ordinary GEMV operands. Host partial sums are an operator composition, not inherently a hardware extension.
backends.unverified: Accumulator/output width, scale, saturation and rounding. Per-plane different inputs and PB replay also remain unverified.
backends.CR_dependency: GEMV composition does not algebraically require CR-read; ordinary-read timing and ECC assumptions need separate accounting.
backends.artifact_maturity: This workspace has a runnable metadata/timing emulator, not numeric GEMV output. No original public numeric AiF artifact verified.
backends.qualification: Architecture-level composition conditional on numerical output contract; no silicon/commercial deployment claim.

backends.name: Cambricon-LLM
backends.read_depth: SectionsIV-A/B/C,V-A/B,VII-A/B/C; Fig7 and equations; legal arXiv PDF text searched for numerical-contract details.
backends.published_evidence: SectionV splits input columns across channels and output rows across cores. Each atomic tile is one NAND page. Input broadcasts within a channel; each core computes its tile. SectionIV-B returns result vectors from output buffers to NPU. A Compute Core is shared by planes and only one plane occupies it at a time.
backends.linear_tile_expression: Explicit 2D atomic tiling already exists. Column partials must be combined mathematically; NPU is the documented return endpoint, but the paper does not explicitly name the partial-sum reducer.
backends.unverified: Exact reducer component/opcode, accumulator/output type, scale and rounding; arbitrary asymmetric per-expert tiling control.
backends.CR_dependency: Read-compute is distinct from CR-read; own page-read/core/channel scheduling applies.
backends.artifact_maturity: Original evaluation modifies SSDsim and uses NPU simulation and synthesized compute logic. A separate third-party timing reconstruction passed smoke tests; it has no numeric tensors.
backends.qualification: Strong architectural prior for 2D tiling, not verified native numerical ABI or fabricated NAND.

backends.name: SLIM die-level NSP
backends.version: arXiv v1 2025-07-12; avoid confusing preprint/acceptance year with journal publication date
backends.read_depth: Sections5.1,5.4,6.1,6.3,7.1,7.3,7.5,7.6; Figs10-11 and hardware table. Author repository README/tree and Torch source inspected.
backends.published_evidence: Section5.4 issues GEMM commands, caches partial sums in PE output SRAM and issues reduce commands to collect and accumulate across PEs. Fused FFN completes each neuron's gate/up vectors before nonlinear/down computation. Dense die-level without prediction is an evaluated baseline. Section7.6 excludes multi-plane read.
backends.linear_tile_expression: Linear GEMM plus cross-PE reduction is described. Down/hidden-neuron partial sums naturally fit the fused flow. Arbitrary gate/up input-column splitting needs reduction before activation; that unfused control is not documented.
backends.unverified: Native command fields, projection-only/unfused mode, externally fixed mask control, accumulator/output width, scale and rounding.
backends.CR_dependency: No CR-read requirement; no AiF four-plane-wave timing transfer.
backends.artifact_maturity: Modified MQSim/TransPIM and synthesized HDL are reported. Public author sparse-ffn-llm is Torch model software, not the FTL/PE simulator or HDL.
backends.qualification: Count only die-level NSP as in-flash; channel-level NSP and DRAM PIM are different execution locations.

backends.name: Conduit
backends.read_depth: Sections4.3.1-4.4; author HPCA slides title page; public Zenodo artifact descriptions, not restricted files.
backends.published_evidence: Vectorized operations are transformed into each resource's ISA. IFP uses Flash-Cosmos multi-wordline sensing and Ares-Flash shift-and-add, not a disclosed GEMV tile opcode. Compiler uses4096-element vectors with32-bit operands. Controller/DRAM/flash operations are separate resource choices.
backends.linear_tile_expression: General vector arithmetic is an architectural composition opportunity; it is not evidence for the same native digital NAND GEMV tile/output interface or its cost.
backends.unverified: Public executable native tile interface, complete numeric result contract and numerical GEMV execution.
backends.CR_dependency: Different IFP mechanisms and constraints; cannot substitute AiF ordinary-read or CR-read timing.
backends.artifact_maturity: Official Zenodo descriptions advertise a SimPy instruction-trace timing simulator; record20621620 files were Restricted when checked. No matching public GitHub artifact verified.
backends.qualification: Do not count controller execution or DRAM PIM as a second NAND GEMV backend.

search_limit: Targeted GitHub repository searches for AiF+flash+LLM, NAND+GEMV, SLIM+NSP, NVLLM, and Conduit+SSD did not identify another matching public numerical digital-NAND GEMV implementation. This is a bounded search result, not a universal nonexistence claim. Unrelated commercial MLU software, GPU Flash-LLM, analog crossbars and embedded CPU flash loads are excluded.

decision.architectural_portability_claim_supporte: Some published digital NAND/NSP designs provide linear tiles and reductions without CR-read. Cambricon already uses2D page atoms; SLIM explicitly reduces PE partials. Exact candidate interface and numerical semantics remain conditional.
decision.claim_not_supported: Identical2D GU composition was executed numerically on two native NAND backends, or AiF timing transfers to another architecture.
decision.minimum_next_evidence: An original functional kernel/ISA or RTL showing output type/scale and pre-activation partial reduction. Compare known dense rows and column tiles against the same backend's unsplit operator, including mixed signs, extrema, scaling and rounding.
decision.effort_gate: Parent's full-cost preliminary gains are only about2.2% for Granite4 and1% for Qwen before host reduction. Do not build a large portability layer until numerical/interface evidence and measured host costs leave a positive margin.
decision.novelty_boundary: 2D tiling and generic partial-sum reduction are strong prior art. Any eventual contribution must be a concrete legal physical mapping/scheduling improvement against that prior, not the composition identity.
